title: Technical Lead Manager, Simulation Infrastructure
searchText: Technical Lead Manager, Simulation Infrastructure Waymo Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states. Want to build the next generation of infrastructure for driverless cars? Join the Waymo Simulation Infrastructure team, and help power the future of transportation! We are looking for a passionate Staff SWE who wants to help build and manage planet-scale distributed systems. If you're someone who's curious and passionate about solving deep technical problems, and love collaborating across many teams to develop and deliver reliable, scalable, and cost-effective Infra services and tools, then we'd like to meet you! In this role will report to a Senior Staff Software Engineer/TLM. You will: Lead an Infrastructure team that builds and maintains reliable, highly-scalable, and cost-effective production services to run Simulation-based Evaluation of the Waymo Driver Set the technical vision and direction for your team, and also influence the direction of the broader Infrastructure Organization. Manage a team of 3-4 junior and senior SWEs, Contribute production grade code, execute code reviews, drive and influence detailed technical designs Align and define plans for your team in addition to influencing planning and strategy of partners and the larger Organization You have: Hands-on experience building large-scale distributed systems Proficient in C++, or a desire or openness to learn C++ 2+ years directly managing Software Engineers Demonstrated experience working cross functionally with Product, Program, Data Science, etc. History of data-driven decision-making It's a bonus if you have: Experience working with different types of large scale systems Familiarity with Google infrastructure (e.g. Flume, Borg) 10+ years experience in software development #LI-Hybrid Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver.
